bug_report:
[12 Regression] Input/output asm operand is not loaded inside a constructor with a virtual base class sincer0-116348-g660584689a4397
Createdattachment 35620[details]Testcase

When inline assembly is used inside a constructor of a class with a virtual base class, and the inline assembly block has an input/output operand, GCC fails to load the value of the operand into a corresponding register.

The attached code, compiled with GCC 5.1, produces

a.out: test.cpp:16: B::B(): Assertion `x == 42' failed.

This happens with both -O2 and -O0. Remove 'virtual' or place the code in a regular function, and the assertion will succeed. Marking the ctor as inline also makes the assertion succeed.
